newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Brewers spur Abidjan bourse to 5th weekly rise.
newsitem.headline: Brewers spur Abidjan bourse to 5th weekly rise.

text.p: The Abidjan Stock Exchange (BVA) rose for a fifth successive week, with another surge in the blue-chip index led once again by brewers SOLIBRA, its market report showed on Friday.
The All-Share Index rose 1.38 percent to 384.37 points, taking the rise for the year to 7.34 percent.
The 12 VB blue-chip index, which lagged in early January, rose 2.68 percent to 262.81 points after surging 4.22 percent the previous week. The rise for the year was 8.61 percent.
A total of 6,965 shares changed hands compared to 13,062 the previous week.
The value of shares traded totalled 191,049,000 CFA francs compared to 258,220,500 CFA the previous week and 315,515,500 CFA the week before that.

Brewers SOLIBRA (+3,640 CFA to 75,400 CFA) led risers for a second successive week after jumping 6,660 CFA the previous week. Other major risers were vehicle sellers SAFCA (+1,820 to 19,670), maritime company SIVOM (+1,620 to 19,320), electricity company CIE (+1,270 to 13,720) and coconut processor SICOR (+830 to 22,030).
